lead: Serious protein, entirely plant-based. 21 g of complete vegan protein per serving from fava bean and fermented yeast — with real cocoa for a rich chocolate shake — to support muscle growth and repair after exercise. Dairy-free, soy-free, no gums.
note: 24 servings · Chocolate · 29.4 oz (833 g) · ships in 1–2 days

science.title: A complete protein, no dairy
science.text: Most plant proteins are chalky or incomplete. We pair fava bean protein isolate with YESTEIN fermented yeast protein — together they deliver all nine essential amino acids, including the leucine that drives muscle repair — for 21 g of smooth, complete protein per serving. Real cocoa makes it taste like a treat, MCT adds clean energy, and it's naturally vegan.

format.title: Plant protein that mixes smooth
format.text: No grit, no beany aftertaste — fava and yeast protein with apple pectin for a smooth, rich chocolate shake in water or plant milk. Sweetened with stevia, not sugar.

absorb.title: Build muscle, plant-powered
absorb.lead: Complete plant protein delivers the amino acids — especially leucine — your muscles use to repair and grow after training.

points.title: Complete amino profile
points.text: Fava bean plus fermented yeast covers all nine essential amino acids — not always the case with single-source plant proteins.

points.title: Muscle repair
points.text: Enough leucine and protein to support muscle growth and recovery after exercise, entirely dairy-free.

points.title: Easy on digestion
points.text: MCT and apple pectin make it smooth and gentle — no soy, no gums, no dairy.

ingredients.title: Two plant proteins + cocoa
ingredients.lead: Fava and fermented yeast for complete protein, real cocoa for taste.*

items.name: Fava Bean Protein
items.text: A clean, hypoallergenic plant protein rich in the branched-chain amino acids that drive muscle repair.

items.name: YESTEIN™ Yeast Protein
items.text: Fermented nutritional-yeast protein that rounds out the amino profile to make it a complete protein.

items.name: Real Cocoa
items.text: Two premium cocoa powders for a genuinely rich chocolate taste — no artificial flavour, no added sugar.

items.name: MCT Oil Powder
items.text: Medium-chain fats for clean energy and a smoother, creamier shake.

facts.note: ** The % Daily Value (DV) tells you how much a nutrient in a serving contributes to a daily diet (2,000 calories a day used for general advice). *** Daily Value (DV) not established.
facts.other: Ingredients: Fava Bean Protein Isolate, YESTEIN™ Fermented Nutritional Yeast Protein, Nidau Cocoa Powder, Natural Flavor, MCT Oil Powder, Nightfall Black Cocoa Powder, Apple Pectin Powder, Sea Salt, Sunflower Lecithin, Stevia Extract (leaf).
facts.side_text: 21 g of complete vegan protein from fava bean and fermented yeast, for just 110 calories and 1 g of sugar — flavoured with real cocoa and sweetened with stevia. No dairy, no soy. Made in the USA — 833 g, 24 servings.
facts.warning: Made to a plant-based formula. If you are pregnant, nursing, under 18, taking medication or have a medical condition, consult a physician before use.

steps.title: Two scoops in liquid
steps.text: Add 2 scoops (34.7 g) to 8–10 oz of water or plant milk and shake until smooth.

steps.title: After training
steps.text: Have it within ~30–60 minutes of a workout to support muscle growth and repair.

steps.title: Or any time you need protein
steps.text: Use it between meals or as a quick plant-based breakfast to hit your protein target.

series.label: Recovery

series.text: Daily plant protein after training was associated with faster recovery and feeling more ready for the next session over the programme.

series.label: Strength

series.text: Consistent complete-protein intake supported steady strength gains and the ability to train harder week to week.

series.text: High-protein, low-sugar plant shakes tracked with lean-muscle progress and feeling fuller between meals.
